prompt: A mail server is found to be an open relay. Which actions help prevent open relaying while still receiving company mail? (Choose two.)
choices: Configure netfilter to block port `25` on the public network
Configure Dovecot to support IMAP connectivity
Restrict Postfix to only accept e-mail for domains hosted on this server
Upgrade the mailbox format from mbox to maildir
Restrict Postfix to only relay outbound SMTP from the internal network
explanation: Limiting `mydestination`/relay to hosted domains and only relaying from the internal network closes the open relay while still receiving mail.
